company_name: Wuxi AJ Anti-Static Intelligence Technology Co., LTD
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company provides anti-static solutions critical for semiconductor fabrication and handling processes.
summary: Wuxi AJ Anti-Static Intelligence Technology Co., LTD develops and manufactures anti-static products essential for semiconductor fabrication and handling. Their solutions help mitigate static electricity, ensuring the protection and quality of semiconductor components during production.

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Wuxi City, Jiangsu Province, operating within the Photoelectric Industrial Park.
